definitions.short: Elihu , the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites
definitions.full: H453. Elihu אֱלִיהוּ Job 32:4 3 t.; אֱלִיהוּא 32:2 6 t.; proper name, masculine ( He is (my) God ) a. the young friend of Job Job 32:2 , 4 , 5 , 6 ; 34:1 ; 35:1 ; 36:1 . b. an Ephraimite, Samuel's great-grandfather 1Sam 1:1 compare אֱלִיאָב 1Chr 6:12 , אֱלִיאֵל v. 6:19 . c. chief of Manasseh 1Chr 12:20 . d. a Korahite 1Chr 26:7 . e. one of the brethren of David 1Chr 27:18 (compare אֱלִיאָב 1Sam 16:6 ).
definitions.rootNote: or (fully) אֱלִיהוּא ; from 410 and 1931 ; God of him;
